items.z: 天上满是飞机。

items.e: The lord held absolute power over his subjects.
items.z: 领主对他的臣民有绝对权力。

items.e: I haven't got any cash. Can I write a cheque?
items.z: 我没现金，写张支票可以吗？

items.e: What storey is our room?
items.z: 我们的房间在几楼？

items.e: This is the worst movie I have ever seen.
items.z: 这是我看过的最差劲的电影了。

items.e: Every bush and tree looks like an enemy.
items.z: 草木皆兵。

items.e: The old stone building was once used as a gaol.
items.z: 这座石头老建筑曾被用作监狱。

items.e: Switzerland is situated between France, Italy, Austria and Germany.
items.z: 瑞士位于法国、意大利、奥地利和德国之间。

items.e: We spent a cosy evening reading by the fireplace.
items.z: 我们在壁炉边读书，度过了温暖舒适的一晚。

items.e: All cats are grey in the dark.
items.z: 猫在黑暗中都是灰色的。

items.e: Many people are sceptical of this unproven new method.
items.z: 很多人对这个未经证实的新方法持怀疑态度。

items.e: She wore a small ruby ring on her finger.
items.z: 她手指上戴着一枚小小的红宝石戒指。

items.e: He asked me if I like maths.
items.z: 他问我喜不喜欢数学。

items.e: Please despatch the boxes before noon on Friday.
items.z: 请在周五中午前把箱子发出去。

items.e: Do you know the Heimlich manoeuvre?
items.z: 你知道海姆利克急救法吗？

items.e: After the king's death Elsa became queen.
items.z: 国王死后，艾莎成为了女王。

items.e: The jeweler mounted a big pearl in the brooch.
items.z: 宝石师傅在胸针上镶了一枚大珍珠。

items.e: The eagle does not catch flies.
items.z: 老鹰不会去抓苍蝇。

items.e: That pasture is ten acres.
items.z: 那个牧场有十英亩大。

items.e: A single bacterium can divide into two within hours.
items.z: 一个细菌能在几小时内分裂成两个。

items.e: Toss it into the rubbish bin.
items.z: 给丢到垃圾桶里去。

items.e: These cardboard boxes are a hundred per cent recyclable.
items.z: 这些纸板盒是百分之百可回收的。

items.e: The temperature today is around twenty five degrees centigrade.
items.z: 今日气温在二十五摄氏度左右。

items.e: This small plant only grows a few centimetres each month.
items.z: 这株小植物每个月仅生长几厘米。

items.e: Excuse me, which subway line is to the city centre?
items.z: 抱歉，地铁几号线去市中心？

items.e: We are here in the name of Jesus Christ and King Charles.
items.z: 我们这里以耶稣基督和查理斯国王之名。

items.e: Please send my sincere congratulation to your newly promoted colleague.
items.z: 请向你新近升职的同事转达我诚挚的祝贺。

items.e: The criterion of the scientific status of a theory is its falsifiability, or refutability, or testability.
items.z: 一个理论的科学地位的标准是它的可证伪性、可反驳性或可检验性。

items.e: Columbus sailed farther west to look for a new continent.
items.z: 哥伦布航行至遥远的西方，去寻找一个新大陆。

items.e: Five gallons of regular, please.
items.z: 请照平常一样五加仑。

items.e: He is on goods terms with all of his classmates.
items.z: 他和他所有的同学相处融洽。

items.e: Each sugar cube in the bag weighs exactly one gramme.
items.z: 袋子里的每块方糖重量恰好为一克。

items.e: How much does a kilo of bananas cost?
items.z: 一公斤香蕉多少钱?

items.e: My city is fifty kilometres from the capital.
items.z: 我的城市离首都五十千米。

items.e: This bottle of pure water holds two full litres in total.
items.z: 这瓶纯净水总共有整整两升。

items.e: China has the means to destroy your aircraft carriers.
items.z: 中国有能力摧毁你们的航空母舰。

items.e: String is sold by the metre.
items.z: 绳子按米卖。

items.e: My house is only a mile from here.
items.z: 我的家离这里只有一英里。

items.e: An ounce of prevention is worth a pound of cure.
items.z: 预防胜于治疗。

items.e: What is permitted to Jove is not permitted to an ox.
items.z: 朱庇特能做的，公牛做不得。

items.e: When I was little, I would only wear pants.
items.z: 我小时候只穿裤子。

items.e: His ideas never earned him a single penny.
items.z: 他的看法真是一文不值。

items.e: I'm not one hundred percent convinced of that.
items.z: 我不是百分之百确定。

items.e: Beer is sold by the pint.
items.z: 啤酒论品脱卖。

items.e: At the meeting he monopolized the discussion and completely disrupted the proceeding.
items.z: 在这次会议上, 他垄断了讨论并彻底打乱了议程。

items.e: Do you want to watch this TV programme?
items.z: 你想看这个电视节目吗？

items.e: I want a quart of milk.
items.z: 我要一夸脱的牛奶。

items.e: One day you'll realise how important saving is.
items.z: 有朝一日你会懂得存钱的重要性的。

items.e: This grizzly bear weighs half a ton.
items.z: 这只灰熊有0.5吨重。

items.e: Cold air turned the vapour into small drops.
items.z: 冷空气使水汽变成了小水滴。

items.e: This battery supplies twelve volts to the motor.
items.z: 这节电池向电机提供十二伏电压。

items.e: A bright lamp may use sixty watts of power.
items.z: 一盏明亮的灯可能要用六十瓦的电。
